text:
jamie: FYI a customer hit our sampleapp onboarding and got a SchemaValidationError during fn call parsing. They saw an `Unexpected token` JSON parse error after function_call.

leila: can you paste the exact error?

jamie: sure - from the sampleapp logs:
```
Error: JSONParseError: Unexpected token ',' at position 432
  at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
  at validateResponse (/usr/src/app/sdk/parse.go:211)
  at handleFnCall (/srv/onboard/main.go:98)
```
Raw assembled payload (logged): `{"action":"create_user","data":{"email":"foo@bar.com",},}`

nate: whoa trailing commas - looks like the final assembled stream inserted extra commas. Are we doing any post-stream concatenation that might add separators on retries?

jamie: we're using the Go SDK stream assembler. We recently shipped the auth retry change; when a token refresh happens mid-stream the SDK replays the request. If the assembler doesn't reset its internal delimiter state between attempts it can leave a trailing comma or duplicate separator. Repro steps I used:
1) set auth TTL to 2s locally
2) force streaming fn_call with small chunk size
3) cause token refresh during stream
4) get final payload with trailing commas

yara: similar reports from support earlier but they blamed model output. I inspected a few raw token slices and the model emits "data":{"email":"foo@bar.com" then `,}` as separate chunks in some cases. Combining that with a stale comma leads to `,},}`.

eng-bot: created issue #2475 (devex/sdk): "go sdk: stream reassembly leaves trailing commas when retrying auth" assigned to @nate. Labels: [bug, sdk, onboarding].

nate: immediate mitigation for sampleapp: add a small tolerant sanitizer that strips trailing commas before parsing. I'll make it feature-flagged (STRICT_JSON=true default in prod). Longer term SDK fix: ensure assembler resets buffer and delimiter state on retry and add unit tests that simulate chunk boundaries at punctuation.

leila: parity note: JS SDK already resets assembler state correctly; Python SDK also strict-parses and will fail early (which surfaced some customers). We should align behavior: either all SDKs enforce strict JSON by default or all provide the same lenient fallback.

jamie: customers are blocked on onboarding so let's push the sanitizer hotfix to sampleapp and flip feature flag for affected customers. Then ship SDK patch next week.

yara: i'll open an eng-ml thread too to confirm the model hasn't started emitting extra commas intentionally (unlikely but worth sanity check).

nate: tests I'll add: streaming retry unit that injects token-expiry mid-stream, assert assembler buffer is reset; sanitizer integration test; and an e2e with sampleapp using a fake auth server.

leila: make sure to add a migration note in changelog and a small guide in sampleapp README about toggling STRICT_JSON for customers who need immediate relief.

jamie: thank you. i'll notify support with the workaround. :thumbsup:
